title: Import a project from a local Studio
description: Upload a zip with the project folder: it will appear on the server together with its version history and agent chats.
drop: Drop a project zip here or
wrongKind: The file must have a .zip extension.
explain: Zip the whole project folder, including the hidden .hse-studio folder: it keeps the project settings, version history and chats. The archive size is limited by the server.

uploading.lead: Uploading the archive. Keep this window open until the upload finishes.
uploading.label: Uploading the archive

done.title: Project imported
done.lead: "{{name}}" is now on the server. You are its owner.
done.regenerated: The identifier from the archive is already taken, so the project got a new one. The earlier project is untouched.

warnings.remote_needs_access: The project still points at a remote repository, but the server has no access to it. Add access in the project settings to keep syncing.
warnings.records_skipped_one: One build record was not transferred: it points at files on your computer. Build the document again.
warnings.records_skipped_other: {{count}} build and submission records were not transferred: they point at files on your computer. Build the documents again.
warnings.store_hardened: Foreign hooks and settings were removed from the version store ({{count}}): they never run on the server.
warnings.junk_skipped: System junk files (.DS_Store, __MACOSX and alike) were skipped: {{count}}.
warnings.chats_unreadable: The agent chats could not be read, the project was transferred without them.

failure.title: Could not import
failure.generic: The import failed. Check the connection and try again.
